lines.text: What if tomorrow morning, every human on Earth suddenly gained the ability to read minds?
No secrets. No lies. No hidden thoughts.
Every thought inside your head could be heard by everyone around you.
At first, humanity experiences complete chaos.
Relationships collapse as hidden feelings are exposed. Friendships end. Political leaders lose public trust. Criminals can no longer hide their intentions.
Even the smallest conversations become terrifying.
Because people can finally hear what others truly think about them.
Within weeks, governments introduce strict laws against thinking about certain things.
Schools begin teaching children how to control their thoughts.
People stop meeting face-to-face.
Silence becomes the most valuable luxury in the world.
But nobody can control what their brain thinks.
Then scientists discover something impossible.
Millions of people across different countries are hearing the exact same thought.
A thought that doesn't belong to any human.
It appears inside every mind simultaneously.
And it is getting louder.
Scientists trace the mysterious thought to a source beyond Earth.
For thousands of years, humanity believed it was developing the ability to read minds.
But the truth is far more terrifying.
Humans aren't reading each other's thoughts.
Something else is using every human brain as a receiver.
And suddenly, billions of minds receive one final message.
We have finally found you.
